name: Trinity Restored
plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)
canDoWhy: It follows straight on from The Pursuit, once you've brought Mercer's plans to Brynjolf.

needs.what: Finish The Pursuit (bring the plans from Riftweald Manor to Brynjolf)

starts.where: with Brynjolf, where you handed him the plans at the end of The Pursuit (the Ragged Flagon, Riften)
starts.how: After Brynjolf reads Mercer's plans and decides the Eyes of the Falmer are in Irkngthand, Karliah asks to speak to you both before you go after Mercer.

takesYou.place: the old standing stone outside Riften's southwest gate

takesYou.why: follow Karliah there, put on the Nightingale armor and take the Oath to Nocturnal

objectives: Meet Karliah at the standing stone

rewards.what: Nightingale armor set: Nightingale Hood, Nightingale Armor, Nightingale Gloves, Nightingale Boots
rewards.when: from the Armor Stone in Nightingale Hall, partway through

rewards.what: You become a Nightingale, sworn to Nocturnal and the Twilight Sepulcher

people.name: Karliah
people.role: leads you to the standing stone and Nightingale Hall and gives the Oath

people.name: Brynjolf
people.role: comes with you and joins the Nightingales too

people.name: Nocturnal
people.role: appears during the Oath

unsure.why: The quest has no start script in these files; that it begins on its own when The Pursuit ends is read from its first journal line and Brynjolf's Irkngthand line being filed under this quest. Karliah's only placement in the records is Snow Veil Sanctum, not where she stands at this point.
The quest holds four Nightingale armor pieces, but the records carry several versions of each (two leveled 'player' versions and a stronger one); which version you get isn't shown here.
Nightingale Hall has no hold in the places file; it is listed as next to Riften, so The Rift is assumed.

evidence: giver INFO Skyrim.esm:0587FE Brynjolf, Karliah stage<20
INFO Skyrim.esm:091942 / 0D7D66 Brynjolf Irkngthand plans line (TG08A)
place Nightingale Hall Skyrim.esm:039AA9 (hold null, Riften 0.2 km)

name: Blindsighted
plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp; Dawnguard.esm also edits it)
canDoWhy: It begins when Trinity Restored ends and Karliah sends you after Mercer at Irkngthand.

starts.where: Nightingale Hall, near Riften, at the end of Trinity Restored
starts.how: Once you've taken the Oath and spoken to Karliah and Brynjolf, you're sent on to Irkngthand, where they'll wait for you inside.

takesYou.why: meet Karliah and Brynjolf inside, then track down Mercer Frey and the Eyes of the Falmer

rewards.what: The Skeleton Key of Nocturnal (taken from Mercer's body; you carry it until you return it in Darkness Returns)

people.name: Karliah
people.role: waits for you inside Irkngthand and fights beside you

people.name: Brynjolf
people.role: waits for you inside Irkngthand and fights beside you

people.name: Mercer Frey
people.role: the target; killed in the depths of Irkngthand

unsure.why: The quest's script also holds a Nightingale Bow, but it is labelled as an NPC's bow, so these files don't show it going to you. What else Mercer carries isn't in these files.
Bronze Water Cave (The Pale) is also tied to this quest in the places file, likely where you come out when escaping, but the records here don't say so plainly.
No start script is in these files; the hand-off from Trinity Restored is read from the journal lines.

name: Darkness Returns
plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by Wintersun - Faiths of Skyrim.esp)
canDoWhy: It begins after Blindsighted, once you've escaped Irkngthand with the Skeleton Key and spoken to Karliah.

starts.where: outside Irkngthand, after the escape at the end of Blindsighted
starts.how: Karliah tells you the Skeleton Key must go back to the Twilight Sepulcher, a journey you make alone.

takesYou.why: return the Skeleton Key to the Ebonmere; it is a short walk from Falkreath

choices.choice: Choose your Nightingale role at the end
choices.leadsTo: You get one Nightingale power: Nightingale Strife, Nightingale Subterfuge, or the shadow power (Shadowcloak of Nocturnal in LoreRim)

objectives: Return the Skeleton Key to the Ebonmere

rewards.what: One Nightingale power, by your choice: Nightingale Strife, Nightingale Subterfuge, or Shadowcloak of Nocturnal
rewards.when: at the end, when you choose your role

closes: The Skeleton Key is returned to the Ebonmere and leaves your inventory

people.name: Nightingale Sentinel (the spirit of Gallus)
people.role: met inside the Twilight Sepulcher; warns you the other guardian spirits have turned hostile

people.name: Nystrom
people.role: a dead pilgrim inside the Sepulcher; his journal is optional

people.name: Nocturnal
people.role: appears at the Ebonmere in the inner sanctum

people.name: Karliah
people.role: speak to her after Nocturnal to choose your role

unsure.why: The three powers are named only by their records (Nightingale Strife, Nightingale Subterfuge, and the shadow power that NightingalePowersRedone.esp renames Shadowcloak of Nocturnal); these files don't tie each one to the choice directly, and the quest script lists only the Nightingale Shadow Perk and the Skeleton Key perk.
Wintersun - Faiths of Skyrim.esp edits this quest last, but these files don't show what it changes.
Where Karliah stands when the quest begins isn't in these files; her only placement is Snow Veil Sanctum. Whether you need to be at the end of Blindsighted for it to start is read from the journal.
Under New Management may need this quest done, but these files don't show its unlock conditions.

evidence: giver INFO Skyrim.esm:0E107B Karliah stage<20; Nightingale Sentinel Skyrim.esm:01BB5D stage<21
script QF_TG09_00021555 pTGSkeletonKeyPerk Skyrim.esm:10F13F, TGNightingaleShadowPerk Skyrim.esm:105874

name: Reparations
canDoWhy: It only starts if you break one of the Thieves Guild's rules and get banned.

needs.what: Be a member of the Thieves Guild and break one of its rules

starts.who: the guild's leaders (Mercer Frey, Brynjolf or Delvin Mallory)
starts.where: the Ragged Flagon and its Cistern, under Riften
starts.how: After you break a guild rule, they tell you you're banned; once things calm down, you ask Vex how to make it right.

firstStep: Speak to Vex in the Ragged Flagon

takesYou.why: talk to Vex and pay her

rewards.what: You're let back into the Thieves Guild

people.name: Vex
people.role: tells you the price and takes your gold; placed in the Ragged Flagon

people.name: Mercer Frey, Brynjolf, Delvin Mallory
people.role: tell you you've been banned

unsure.why: The records don't say which rules get you banned; the journal only says 'one of their cardinal rules'.
5,000 gold is the starting value of the price; the quest script could set a different amount.
Vex is placed in the Ragged Flagon; her daily schedule isn't in these files.

evidence: giver INFO Skyrim.esm:0B0396 Mercer stage<11; Brynjolf, Delvin stage<11; Vex stage<30

plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)
canDoWhy: It starts when you pick up one of the Unusual Gems lying around Skyrim.

takesYou.why: show Vex the gem and hand in the crown

takesYou.place: wherever the 24 Stones of Barenziah lie; the places file lists Ansilvund, Hall of Victory and Stony Creek Cave (Eastmarch); Pinewatch and Sunderstone Gorge (Falkreath); Mistveil Keep (The Rift); Dragonsreach, Fellglow Keep, the Hall of the Dead, Jorrvaskr and Rannveig's Fast (Whiterun); Hob's Fall Cave, the College of Winterhold and Yngvild (Winterhold)

takesYou.why: recover the Crown of Barenziah; near Shor's Stone

objectives: Become a full member of the Thieves Guild
Bring the Unusual Gem to Vex in the Thieves Guild

rewards.when: when you return the crown to Vex

people.name: Vex
people.role: appraises the gem and restores the crown; placed in the Ragged Flagon

people.name: Maul
people.role: in Riften; can point you to Vex if you ask him about the gem

unsure.why: The places file leaves out cities, towns and houses, so the list of stone locations isn't complete.
The records don't say which guild quest makes you a 'full member'.
Prowler's Profit is named in the quest script, but it isn't in the spell or power files here, so what it does in LoreRim isn't shown.
That Maul is the one who points you to Vex is read from the gem handler's journal ('With Maul in Riften no longer speaking to me').
